Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.projectile

Class Projectile

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.Entity
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.projectile.Projectile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rewindable, Collidable, Updatable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Arrow, Fireball
public abstract class Projectile extends Entity
A shot that flies straight until a wall stops it or its lifetime ends: an arrow, a fireball (GDD 1.3.1). Its hitbox follows it and points where it flies (GDD 1.5). It hurts through its owner's attack, so the owner's decorators, such as a FireTouch, apply to it (GDD 1.4).

Pattern: Template Method (onHit(com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character) is the hook each projectile fills).

  • Constructor Details

    • Projectile

      protected Projectile(Aabb bodyBox, Character owner, float aimDegrees, float speed, int lifetimeTicks, String spriteId, World world)
      Creates a projectile. Its length along its flight is the width of its body box, its thickness the height.
      Parameters:
      bodyBox - where it starts; must not be null
      owner - the character who shot it; its attack and side are the projectile's
      aimDegrees - the direction it flies to, in degrees (0 = right, 90 = up)
      speed - how fast it flies, in pixels per second; above 0
      lifetimeTicks - how many ticks it flies before it is removed; above 0
      spriteId - the picture the renderer draws for it, pointing right; from the data entry of the weapon that fired it
      world - the world it flies in: its walls stop it, its characters can be hurt
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if bodyBox, owner, spriteId or world is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the aim or the speed is not a finite number, the speed is 0 or less, the lifetime is 0 or less, or the sprite id is blank

    • onUpdate

      protected final void onUpdate(long tick)
      Flies one tick: moves by its velocity, then hurts every character its hitbox touches. A wall in the way removes it, and so does the end of its lifetime.
      Specified by:
      onUpdate in class Entity
      Parameters:
      tick - the number of the current logic tick

    • writeState

      public void writeState(StateBuffer out)
      Writes the entity part, then the ticks its hitbox still lasts (GDD 1.1.2). The rest never changes in flight, so it is not saved: the owner, the world and the velocity.
      Specified by:
      writeState in interface Rewindable
      Overrides:

      Parameters:

    • readState

      public void readState(StateBuffer in)
      Puts back what writeState(com.epitech.depthdiablo.engine.StateBuffer) wrote, in the same order, with a new hitbox over the position it is back to. That hitbox has hit no one yet, which is right for a projectile that stops at its first hit, as the arrow does: one in a photo never landed a hit, since that hit removed it and the world dropped it at the end of the tick.
      Specified by:
      readState in interface Rewindable
      Overrides:
      readState in class Entity
      Parameters:
      in - the photo being restored

    • onHit

      protected abstract void onHit(Character target)
      What the projectile does once it hurt a character. A hit on an invincible character, such as one rolling, lands nothing and does not call it.
